_readme: Waivers for eng/check-docs.py, which reads this file from its own directory.
A section that genuinely does not apply should be ABSENT, not filled with a
placeholder - that is the first rule in the README template. This file is how you
tell the checker so. Every waiver needs a reason: a waiver without one cannot be
told apart from giving up.
files   paths relative to the repository root. A bare name such as README.md also
matches any path ending in it; a folder with a trailing slash, such as
docs/, matches everything under it.
checks  the check codes to waive for those files.
reason  why. Required.
